tier_should.rationale: Well-established scholars advance novel, tractable models linking AI, automation, Baumol effects and singularity debates; solid theory, clear contribution, credible; worthy of top field or marginal A journal.

tier_will.rationale: Speculative nature and broad scope may face mixed referee tastes; likely placed in high-quality field or upper-tier review (e.g., AEJ, JEP) rather than very top five.
